note: The four folders in the Case Files cabinet, in narrative order. Holdings summarized from the public opinions.

cases.name: Buchanan v. Warley
cases.holding: A city ordinance mandating racial zoning violates the Fourteenth Amendment.
cases.consequence: Cities cannot draw the color line by law. Segregation goes private.

cases.name: Corrigan v. Buckley
cases.holding: The Court dismisses a challenge to a racial covenant, holding the constitutional claims do not reach private agreements.
cases.consequence: The industry reads the dismissal as permission, and covenants spread block by block.

cases.name: Hansberry v. Lee
cases.holding: The earlier covenant judgment does not bind the Hansberrys, who were never represented in that case.
cases.consequence: A Chicago family wins on procedure. The gate cracks but stands.

cases.name: Shelley v. Kraemer
cases.holding: Court enforcement of a racial covenant is state action forbidden by the Fourteenth Amendment.
cases.consequence: No court in America can enforce the clauses. They stay in the deeds, powerless.
